descriptor.retrieval_description: Cylindrical aluminum beverage can with a smooth, dry, coated exterior surface and continuous curvature. The intended contact region has no visible seams or texture within the centered grasp band.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral sidewall surfaces located centrally along the vertical axis of the can
descriptor.local_geometry: Smooth cylindrical curvature with a continuous, uniform profile
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible from the top-down perspective
descriptor.uncertainty: The side of the can facing away from the camera is partially obscured, but the overall cylindrical geometry is clearly evident.
